Maharashtra weather: Ratnagiri sizzles at 34.5 degrees Celsius, Yavatmal coolest in the state
Ratnagiri recorded Maharashtra's highest maximum temperature at 34.5 degrees Celsius, while Yavatmal was the coolest at 11.4 degrees Celsius on Thursday. Mumbai recorded 33.2 degrees Celsius as the IMD reported no rainfall across the state
Ratnagiri, along the Konkan coast, recorded 34.5 degrees Celsius, the highest maximum temperature reported in the IMD bulletin. FILE PIC/ASHISH RAJE
Ratnagiri recorded Maharashtra's highest maximum temperature at 34.5 degrees Celsius on Thursday, while Yavatmal reported the lowest minimum temperature at 11.4 degrees Celsius, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD). No rainfall was recorded at the reporting stations across the state. Meanwhile, Mumbai recorded a maximum temperature of 33.2 degrees Celsius and a minimum of 25 degrees Celsius.
Mumbai, MMR record warm day
Mumbai's Santacruz weather station (representative of the suburbs) recorded a maximum temperature of 33.6 degrees Celsius and a minimum of 22.6 degrees Celsius. Alibag recorded a high of 33.8 degrees Celsius and a low of 24.6 degrees Celsius, while Dahanu reported 33.9 degrees Celsius as its maximum and 19.3 degrees Celsius as its minimum.
